Overview

Agentic AI & Hyperautomation for Healthcare & Life Sciences earns its budget only when it changes a number on someone's scorecard. So we invert the usual sequence: lock the metric and its baseline first, then work backwards to the smallest architecture that moves it — usually composed from EHR integration and the tower platform rather than built from scratch. What makes Healthcare & Life Sciences different is not the math; it is the operating context: HIPAA / HITECH governs the data, clinical reality governs the economics, and the people accountable for outcomes answer to regulators as well as customers. Every design choice below is downstream of that context.
